evidence: Plin. NH 34.163: India neque aes neque plumbum habet (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Fam. 5.6: habēre aes aliēnum (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Any ore but gold and silver, above all copper, and its alloy with tin, bronze; then anything made of it, and money, which was first of copper. Aes aliēnum, another’s money, is debt (Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: India neque aes neque plumbum habet
phrases.english: India has neither copper nor lead

sources: Lewis & Short: aes
